pages.text: A head out in the world uses 1 mB of saline every 12 seconds. A docked or carried head uses none. A dry jar loses $(l)Jar Integrity$(), and integrity is the glass between you and the world.
The $(item)Saline Mixer$() turns water, sugar, kelp and redstone into saline and bottles it. Use bottles on your placed head, put them in the Jar menu, or pipe saline into a Cradle.
